Assesses ability to design end-to-end supply chain security and runtime integrity for multi-cloud CNFs, including identity management, attestation mechanisms, policy-as-code enforcement, and network isolation during zero-downtime upgrades.

- SPIFFE/SPIRE identity management

- OPA/Kyverno policy enforcement

```yaml
apiVersion: spiffe.example/v1
kind: SPIFFEIdentity
metadata:
  name: cnf-identity-01
spec:
  spiffeID: spiffe://cluster/ns/cnf-01
  parentID: spiffe://cluster/ns/workload-scheduler
  ttl: 1h
```

```yaml
# OPA upgrade gate policy
package cnf.upgrade
default allow = false

allow {
  input.attestation.trust_score >= 80
  input.sbom.delta.additions == 0
  input.network_policy.isolated == true
}
```

## Implementation Approach
The solution integrates identity, attestation, and policy enforcement to ensure upgrades maintain security posture while achieving zero downtime through controlled canary deployments.

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked

This question assesses practical knowledge of traffic management in multi-tenant environments. It tests understanding of Istio's traffic splitting capabilities, header-based routing, and safe rollout strategies. Candidates must balance per-tenant isolation against system complexity.

## Key Concepts

- **Istio traffic management**: DestinationRules define service subsets; VirtualServices handle routing rules
- **Canary deployments**: Gradually shift traffic between versions to validate changes safely
- **Header-based routing**: Use x-cluster-local headers or custom headers like X-TENANT-ID to identify tenants
- **Weight-based traffic splitting**: Distribute traffic percentages across subsets

## Code Example

```yaml
apiVersion: networking.istio.io/v1alpha3
kind: DestinationRule
metadata:
  name: cnf-gateway-dr
spec:
  host: cnf-gateway
  subsets:
  - name: prod
    labels:
      version: prod
  - name: canary
    labels:
      version: canary
---
apiVersion: networking.istio.io/v1alpha3
kind: VirtualService
metadata:
  name: cnf-gateway-vs
spec:
  hosts:
  - cnf-gateway
  http:
  - match:
    - headers:
        x-tenant-id:
          exact: canary
    route:
    - destination:
        host: cnf-gateway
        subset: canary
      weight: 15
    - destination:
        host: cnf-gateway
        subset: prod
      weight: 85
  - route:
    - destination:
        host: cnf-gateway
        subset: prod
```

## One-Namespace Test Validation

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: canary-test
  labels:
    istio-injection: enabled
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: cnf-gateway-prod
  namespace: canary-test
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: cnf-gateway
      version: prod
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: cnf-gateway
        version: prod
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: gateway
        image: cnf-gateway:v1
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8080
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: cnf-gateway
  namespace: canary-test
spec:
  ports:
  - port: 80
    targetPort: 8080
  selector:
    app: cnf-gateway
```

Validate with: `curl -H "X-TENANT-ID: canary" http://cnf-gateway/` to confirm routing behavior.

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
This question assesses real-world upgrade discipline in cloud-native networking functions (CNF): zero-downtime deployments, per-tenant TLS key rotation, and reliable KMS-backed certificate flows—all in a multi-tenant Kubernetes environment.

## Key Concepts
- Canary rollouts with per-namespace traffic control using progressive traffic shifting
- CSR-based TLS rotation via an in-cluster KMS-backed Certificate Authority
- TenantRotation CRD to trigger cross-namespace certificate refresh
- Readiness probes with TLS handshake validation during upgrades
- Traffic shadows for testing new versions without affecting production

## Code Example
```yaml
# Example 1: Deployment rolling update strategy
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: gateway
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  replicas: 3
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxSurge: 1
      maxUnavailable: 0
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: gateway
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: gateway
        version: v1.y
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: gateway
        image: gateway:v1.y
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8443
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /ready
            port: 8443
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          periodSeconds: 5
        env:
        - name: KUBERNETES_SERVICE_HOST
          value: "kubernetes.default.svc"
        - name: VAULT_ADDR
          value: "http://vault-in-cluster:8200"
```

```yaml
# Example 2: TenantRotation CRD for per-tenant TLS rotation
apiVersion: cert-manager.io/v1
kind: Certificate
metadata:
  name: tenant-mtls-cert
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  secretName: tenant-a-mtls-secret
  duration: 24h
  renewBefore: 12h
  issuerRef:
    name: kms-tenant-issuer
    kind: ClusterIssuer
  dnsNames:
  - gateway.tenant-a.svc.cluster.local
  commonName: tenant-a
---
apiVersion: security.example.com/v1
kind: TenantRotation
metadata:
  name: tenant-a-rotation
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  tenantNamespace: tenant-a
  certificateRef:
    name: tenant-mtls-cert
  rotationStrategy: rolling
  preRotationValidation:
    enabled: true
    timeout: 30s
```
